title: Caret/selection fidelity from HarfBuzz clusters + inert script/direction fields
outcome: Caret stops derive from HarfBuzz cluster boundaries so carets and selection highlights land correctly under kerning and ligatures; story script/direction/language feed HarfBuzz instead of guessSegmentProperties; per-line compose stops re-shaping every prefix.
before: Gap audit 2026-08-27 (main 14e2812): ShapedRun.glyphs stores only {gid,dx,dy,adv} - the cluster value HarfBuzz returns is dropped (type.ts:60-64, 167-177); caret stops are reconstructed by re-shaping each text prefix and summing advances (emitStops type.ts:398-410) while glyph positions come from shaping the whole line (setLine type.ts:371-387), so any kerning pair or ligature (e.g. 'fi') makes caret x land mid-glyph and selection rectangles (compositor.ts:1229-1243) highlight the wrong span; prefix re-shaping is O(line length) per line; buffer.guessSegmentProperties is the only script input (type.ts:162-164) while story language/script/direction (types.ts:281-285) are inert. Related app-side edge (leased src/app.ts, flagged separately): Backspace deletes one UTF-16 code unit (app.ts:1782-1787) splitting surrogate pairs.
after: caretStops derive from glyph clusters (prefix re-shaping removed), setSegmentProperties feeds story script/direction/language, and mixed-kerning fixtures place carets within 0.5px of glyph origins with correct selection spans.
acceptance: For a kerning+ligature fixture, caret x from caretStops matches shaped glyph origins at every boundary (unit assert, <= 0.5px).
Selection highlight covers exactly the selected glyphs (canvas screenshot).
Pixel output identical to before for runs without kerning-dependent boundaries (regression).
RTL/Arabic fixture shapes and measures with correct direction instead of guessed properties.
npx tsc --noEmit, targeted tests, npm run build pass.
evidence: Caret-boundary unit assertions on kerning/ligature fixture

builder.notes: Serialized behind VIRO-0143 (shared type.ts). app.ts Backspace edge is out of scope here (leased); flagged to Governor for the persistence/app packet.

critic.notes: User-visible caret/selection correctness; light critic pass on screenshots.

delta.before: Carets drift under kerning/ligatures; script fields inert; O(n) re-shapes per line.
delta.after: Cluster-derived carets, honored direction/script, single shape per line.
